en.t: I cannot sleep night after night."
The letter was written with such elegant beauty that it dazzled the eye.

units.source_text: 空蝉热泪满眼，看不清楚。

en.t: Utsusemi's eyes filled with hot tears, and she could not see clearly.

units.source_text: 只是想起自己本来生不逢辰，今又添了这件痛心之事，

en.t: She could only think that she had been born under an unlucky star, and now this heartbreaking matter had been added as well,

units.source_text: 自叹命穷，悲伤不已，便躺下了。

en.t: lamenting her wretched fate and unable to stop grieving, she lay down.
